# trait definitions with aliases and macro params
brave = {
	group = personality
	monthly_prestige = 0.25
}
craven = {
	group = personality
	group_equivalence = fearful_family
	opposites = { brave }
}
education_diplomacy_1 = {
	group = education_diplomacy
	check = $LEVEL$
	also = $LEVEL$
	other = $SKILL$
}
namespace = not_a_def
